# ChronoMap

> ChronoMap is a free, interactive world clock and time zone toolkit. See the current local time anywhere on a 2D map or 3D globe, compare cities, convert times, plan meetings across time zones, and generate Discord timestamps. No account, no ads, works in any browser.

All times use each location's live IANA time zone, so daylight saving time is always handled correctly.

## Core tools

- [World clock map](https://www.chronomap.top/): Interactive world clock on a 2D map and 3D globe. Hover any country for its live local time, pin and compare multiple cities, and travel forwards or backwards through time.
- [Time zone map](https://www.chronomap.top/time-zone-map): The current time in every UTC offset, from UTC−12 to UTC+14, with live clocks for major cities.
- [Meeting planner](https://www.chronomap.top/meeting-planner): Add cities and see everyone's working hours side by side to find the best overlapping time to schedule a call across time zones.
- [Discord timestamp generator](https://www.chronomap.top/discord-timestamp-generator): Turn any date and time into a Discord `<t:UNIX:style>` code that renders in each user's own time zone.

## Cities and comparisons

- [Time zone converter](https://www.chronomap.top/time-zone-converter): Convert any time and date between time zone abbreviations (EST, PST, GMT, IST, SGT and more) or 200 cities, handling daylight saving.
- [Cities](https://www.chronomap.top/time): The current local time in major cities worldwide, with popular time zone conversions.
- Per-city pages: https://www.chronomap.top/time/{city} — live local time, UTC offset, and daylight saving dates.

## Apps

- [ChronoMap for Windows](https://www.chronomap.top/windows): Free ChronoMap app on the Microsoft Store for Windows 10 and 11.

## About

- Publisher: Agenciarse (https://agenciarse.com)
- How the times are calculated, sources and limits: https://www.chronomap.top/about
- All features are free and run client-side; time math uses the browser's IANA time zone database.
